item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"c1","claim_type":"core","weight":30,"statement":"The failing branch uses a `DummyLM` created without `adapter=json_adapter` while the active DSPy adapter is `JSONAdapter`, so `DummyLM` still formats its canned completion with its own default `ChatAdapter` and emits the old `[[ ## field ## ]]` style instead of JSON.","span_ids":["e1","e2","e3"]},{"claim_id":"c2","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"The first prediction call fails with `AdapterParseError`, because `JSONAdapter.parse` only accepts a JSON-object completion and raises when the completion is not a dict or does not match the signature's output fields.","span_ids":["e4"]},{"claim_id":"c3","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"The fix creates a second `DummyLM` with `adapter=json_adapter` and runs the success case under that same JSON adapter, so the assistant-side completion is serialized as JSON and the prediction can return `answer == \"OK\"`.","span_ids":["e2","e5"]},{"claim_id":"c4","claim_type":"supporting","weight":10,"statement":"The runnable proof explicitly exposes the split in behavior by catching and printing the first exception type, then printing and asserting that the matched branch succeeds with the answer `OK`.","span_ids":["e4","e5"]},{"claim_id":"c5","claim_type":"supporting","weight":10,"statement":"The successful branch additionally checks the recorded prompt/history for the JSONAdapter instruction fragment `Outputs will be a JSON object...`, confirming that the matched setup really used JSON-style prompting.","span_ids":["e6"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"e1","path":"dspy/utils/dummies.py","start_line":83,"end_line":87},{"span_id":"e2","path":"dspy/utils/dummies.py","start_line":106,"end_line":120},{"span_id":"e3","path":"dspy/adapters/chat_adapter.py","start_line":248,"end_line":266},{"span_id":"e4","path":"dspy/adapters/json_adapter.py","start_line":148,"end_line":180},{"span_id":"e5","path":"dspy/adapters/json_adapter.py","start_line":183,"end_line":203},{"span_id":"e6","path":"dspy/adapters/json_adapter.py","start_line":104,"end_line":121}]}
